messages:
liz: Heads up — CI microbench for PR #17321 flagged a regression on the kernel-autoselect path after the quant-channel-sampler change. Failing threshold: -9.4% on small-batch latency.

raj: saw that, reproducing locally. smallbench shows tail latency increase for 1-2 token sequences, consistent across runs.

tomas: +1. Looks like the sampler shifted distribution toward shorter sequences; kernel selector now prefers the quant_concat_v2 path for those cases. KV cache hit rate drops ~14% in the bad runs.

ci-bot: microbench/pr-17321 — perf-diff: small-batch-latency -9.4% (threshold -5%). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/prow/pr-17321/artifacts/microbench.json

liz: Pasting the failing snippet from CI: 
```
Bench: small_batch_latency
base: 12.3ms
cur: 13.5ms
delta: -9.4%
kvcache_hit: 0.72 -> 0.62
kernel: quant_concat_autoselect -> quant_concat_v2
```

raj: bisecting locally — regression introduced in commit 5f3a2d8 (quant-channel-sampler: prefer high-channel path for seqLen<=4). Repro 10/10 on my prod-like harness.

karen: Can we add a golden test for seqLen sampler distribution to perf unit tests? This regressed because the sampler shift wasn't covered.

tomas: Quick mitigation idea: tighten kernel-selector fallback for small seqs so it prefers the older kernel when kv hit rate is below X. But that is a heuristic; might be safer to rollback the sampler change while we instrument.

eli: +1 on rollback to stop rollout blocker. Also we should add telemetry for kernel choice vs kv hit and per-seqlen perf.

liz: I'm opening a rollback PR now. PR description: revert commit 5f3a2d8 and add a perf unit that simulates the new seqLen distribution and asserts <=2% regression on small-batch latency.

ci-bot: rollback-pr-17400 created by liz — CI triggered.

raj: local quick commands for repro and revert: 
```
git checkout -b revert/quant-sampler
git revert 5f3a2d8 -m 1
make microbench && ./bin/microbench --profile small_batch
```

karen: I'll pair on the perf unit. Suggest placing it at tests/perf/test_sampler_golden.py and mocking seqLen sampling to match the new distribution.

tomas: Note: this surfaced a secondary pattern — sampler batches shorter sequences more often which increases cold-starts on the kv-prefill path. We should consider sampler-aware kv warmup as a medium-term mitigation.

liz: Agreed. Long-term actions: add sampler-aware kv warmup + kernel-selection telemetry + perf test coverage for sampler distributions. Filed PERF-2718 to track.

ci-bot: rollback-pr-17400 — microbench results: small-batch-latency +0.5% relative to base (within threshold). All checks green.

eli: rolling the rollback to staging now; will monitor the staging telemetry dashboards and the kv hit metric.

liz: After the rollback landed in staging we saw immediate tail-latency improvement and kv hit recovered to ~0.71.

raj: follow-up checklist (short):
- merge rollback PR (liz)
- backfill perf unit test (karen)
- add kernel-choice telemetry and dashboard (eli)
- investigate sampler heuristics and implement kv warmup if needed (tomas + raj)

karen: assigning PERF-2718 to tomas + raj, ETA EOD. I'll shepherd the perf test.

tomas: I'll produce a short perf writeup and a flamegraph attached to the rollback PR comments so we have a record.

ci-bot: Note: perf regression alert for PR-17321 marked resolved after rollback.

liz: Thanks all :tada: I'll merge the rollback once green and open a short postmortem with root cause and follow-ups.
